versions.content: Name ARTI_STOPWATCH_FLAT, ARTI_STOPWATCH_NESTED Kind Enumeration ARTI_STOPWATCH_FLAT 0x00u The stopwatch ignores nesting. Range ARTI_STOPWATCH_ NESTED 0x01u The stopwatch considers nesting. Description This value defines how the start and stop event of a stopwatch is evaluated. The symbols ARTI_STOPWATCH_FLAT and ARTI_STOPWATCH_NESTED shall be defined as follows: 1. define ARTI_STOPWATCH_FLAT 0x00u 2. define ARTI_STOPWATCH_NESTED 0x01u Available via Arti.h
